## Core Capabilities & Services

### 1. Social Media Marketing & Reels Video Production
- Strategic content planning customized for consumer brands, retail, healthcare, and education.
- Scroll-stopping Instagram Reels and short-form video editing engineered for algorithmic reach and virality.
- High-end video shooting, storytelling, color grading, dynamic sound design, and captioning.
- Community management, posting calendars, and organic audience cultivation.

### 2. Performance Marketing & Meta Ads
- Full-funnel Facebook and Instagram advertising campaigns designed for profitable ROAS.
- Average client ROAS achieved: 5.3x.
- B2B lead generation with qualified pre-filtering.
- Hyperlocal target advertising for stores, showrooms, clinics, academies, and service centers in Krishnagiri, Hosur, Salem, and Bengaluru.
- Pixel setup, Conversions API (CAPI), and custom audience retargeting engines.

### 3. Website Design & Conversion Funnels
- Mobile-first, blazing fast responsive business websites and corporate platforms.
- High-converting landing pages tailored for ad campaigns and immediate lead capture.
- Interactive UX/UI, modern typography, glassmorphic styling, and clean semantic architecture.
- Full responsive optimization for iOS, Android, tablets, and desktops.

### 4. Local SEO & Search Engine Optimization
- Google Business Profile optimization to rank #1 in the Local 3-Pack on Google Maps for Krishnagiri and Hosur searches.
- High-intent local keywords optimization targeting "digital marketing near me", "best marketing company in Krishnagiri", "web development Hosur".
- On-page technical SEO, schema markup, site speed optimization, and canonical indexing.

### 5. SaaS Platforms & WhatsApp Automation
- Agency OS: Centralized multi-branch lead routing, staff task management, and client billing.
- WhatsApp Cloud Automation: Automatic lead alerts, proposal delivery, and customer onboarding via WhatsApp API.
- Custom enterprise internal software, dashboards, and automated business workflows.
